system.description:
The smugglers of the Jinia Isles and the Opal docks: rigging, hidden holds and quick exits by sea.

  • Deckhand's Footing: on a ship, a pier, rigging or a cliff path you never fall Prone from footing or motion, and you climb and swim at full speed without a check.
    • 9th level: the first creature you attack after a drop, swing or leap of 10ft or more that turn counts as unable to see you.
  • Smuggler's Stash: on a ship, cart or wagon you find its hidden compartments with 1 minute of searching and no check, and can hide up to 2 slots of goods there that a search finds only by beating your Pick Pocket check. You also have Advantage on checks to bribe or bargain with port officials.
